messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

PROTOCOL: Scalable Device for Automated Microbial Electroporation in a Digital Microfluidic Platform
Authors: Andrew C. Madison, Matthew W. Royal, Frederic Vigneault, Liji Chen, Peter B. Griffin, Mark Horowitz, George M. Church, Richard B. Fair
Journal: ACS Synthetic Biology, 2017
DOI: https://doi.org/10.1021/acssynbio.7b00007
PDF Source: https://pubs.acs.org/asbcd6/article-supplement/683293/pdf/sb7b00007_si_001/

MANIFEST:
- ecnr2_culture
- wash_buffer
- resuspension_buffer
- pgerc_plasmid
- recovery_media
- lb_kan_agar

========================================
PHASE 1: SINGLE PULSE PROTOCOL
========================================
1. cells = dispense 1000 units of ecnr2_culture
2. repeat 2 times:
   - wash = dispense 1000 units of wash_buffer
   - cells = mix cells with wash for 90s
   - dispose wash
3. resusp = dispense 200 units of resuspension_buffer
4. cells = mix cells with resusp for 10s
5. plasmid = dispense 5 units of pgerc_plasmid
6. celldna = mix cells with plasmid for 10s
7. heat celldna at 4c for 15m (900s)
8. heat celldna at 23c for 1s
9. recover = dispense 200 units of recovery_media
10. outgrowth = mix celldna with recover for 60s
11. heat outgrowth at 30c for 60m (3600s)
12. single_pulse_reading = detect fluorescence on outgrowth for 5m (300s)
13. if (single_pulse_reading <= 80):
    - dispose outgrowth
14. plate = dispense 50 units of lb_kan_agar
15. colony = mix outgrowth with plate for 10s
16. dispose colony

========================================
PHASE 2: PULSE TRAIN PROTOCOL
========================================
1. cells2 = dispense 1000 units of ecnr2_culture
2. repeat 2 times:
   - wash2 = dispense 1000 units of wash_buffer
   - cells2 = mix cells2 with wash2 for 90s
   - dispose wash2
3. resusp2 = dispense 200 units of resuspension_buffer
4. cells2 = mix cells2 with resusp2 for 10s
5. plasmid2 = dispense 5 units of pgerc_plasmid
6. celldna2 = mix cells2 with plasmid2 for 10s
7. heat celldna2 at 4c for 15m (900s)
8. repeat 10 times:
   - heat celldna2 at 23c for 1s
9. recover2 = dispense 200 units of recovery_media
10. outgrowth2 = mix celldna2 with recover2 for 60s
11. heat outgrowth2 at 30c for 60m (3600s)
12. train_pulse_reading = detect fluorescence on outgrowth2 for 5m (300s)
13. if (train_pulse_reading <= 80):
    - dispose outgrowth2
14. plate2 = dispense 50 units of lb_kan_agar
15. colony2 = mix outgrowth2 with plate2 for 10s
16. dispose colony2

module fluorescence

manifest ecnr2_culture
manifest wash_buffer
manifest resuspension_buffer
manifest pgerc_plasmid
manifest recovery_media
manifest lb_kan_agar

instructions:

cells = dispense 1000 units of ecnr2_culture

repeat 2 times {
    wash = dispense 1000 units of wash_buffer
    cells = mix cells with wash for 90s
    dispose wash
}

resusp = dispense 200 units of resuspension_buffer
cells = mix cells with resusp for 10s

plasmid = dispense 5 units of pgerc_plasmid
celldna = mix cells with plasmid for 10s
heat celldna at 4c for 15m

heat celldna at 23c for 1s

recover = dispense 200 units of recovery_media
outgrowth = mix celldna with recover for 60s
heat outgrowth at 30c for 60m

single_pulse_reading = detect fluorescence on outgrowth for 5m

if (single_pulse_reading <= 80) {
    dispose outgrowth
}

plate = dispense 50 units of lb_kan_agar
colony = mix outgrowth with plate for 10s
dispose colony

cells2 = dispense 1000 units of ecnr2_culture

repeat 2 times {
    wash2 = dispense 1000 units of wash_buffer
    cells2 = mix cells2 with wash2 for 90s
    dispose wash2
}

resusp2 = dispense 200 units of resuspension_buffer
cells2 = mix cells2 with resusp2 for 10s

plasmid2 = dispense 5 units of pgerc_plasmid
celldna2 = mix cells2 with plasmid2 for 10s
heat celldna2 at 4c for 15m

repeat 10 times {
    heat celldna2 at 23c for 1s
}

recover2 = dispense 200 units of recovery_media
outgrowth2 = mix celldna2 with recover2 for 60s
heat outgrowth2 at 30c for 60m

train_pulse_reading = detect fluorescence on outgrowth2 for 5m

if (train_pulse_reading <= 80) {
    dispose outgrowth2
}

plate2 = dispense 50 units of lb_kan_agar
colony2 = mix outgrowth2 with plate2 for 10s
dispose colony2

	cells1[0] = dispense(ecnr2_culture)
bsbbr_2_h:
	PHI REPEAT_21 = {REPEAT_20,REPEAT_22}
	PHI wash1 = {wash0,wash2}
	PHI cells2 = {cells1,cells3}
	if REPEAT_21[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_3_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_4_f
bsbbr_3_t:
	wash2[0] = dispense(wash_buffer)
	cells3[0] = mix(cells2[0], wash2[0]) @ 90.0SECOND
	dispose(wash2[0])
	REPEAT_22[0] = REPEAT_21[0] - 1
bsbbr_4_f:
	resusp1[0] = dispense(resuspension_buffer)
	cells4[0] = mix(cells2[0], resusp1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	plasmid1[0] = dispense(pgerc_plasmid)
	celldna1[0] = mix(cells4[0], plasmid1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	heat(celldna1[0]) @ 4.0CELSIUS @ 900.0SECOND
	heat(celldna1[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 1.0SECOND
	recover1[0] = dispense(recovery_media)
	outgrowth1[0] = mix(celldna1[0], recover1[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	heat(outgrowth1[0]) @ 30.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	single_pulse_reading1[0] = detect(fluorescence, outgrowth1[0]) @ 300.0SECOND
	if single_pulse_reading1[0] <= 80	|	true: jump bsbbif_5_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_6_f
bsbbif_5_t:
	dispose(outgrowth1[0])
bsbbif_6_f:
	PHI outgrowth2 = {outgrowth1,outgrowth}
	plate1[0] = dispense(lb_kan_agar)
	colony1[0] = mix(outgrowth2[0], plate1[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	dispose(colony1[0])
	cells21[0] = dispense(ecnr2_culture)
bsbbr_7_h:
	PHI wash21 = {wash20,wash22}
	PHI cells22 = {cells21,cells23}
	PHI REPEAT_23 = {REPEAT_21,REPEAT_24}
	if REPEAT_23[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_8_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_9_f
bsbbr_8_t:
	wash22[0] = dispense(wash_buffer)
	cells23[0] = mix(cells22[0], wash22[0]) @ 90.0SECOND
	dispose(wash22[0])
	REPEAT_24[0] = REPEAT_23[0] - 1
bsbbr_9_f:
	resusp21[0] = dispense(resuspension_buffer)
	cells24[0] = mix(cells22[0], resusp21[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	plasmid21[0] = dispense(pgerc_plasmid)
	celldna21[0] = mix(cells24[0], plasmid21[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	heat(celldna21[0]) @ 4.0CELSIUS @ 900.0SECOND
bsbbr_10_h:
	PHI REPEAT_101 = {REPEAT_100,REPEAT_102}
	PHI celldna22 = {celldna21,celldna22}
	if REPEAT_101[0] > 0	|	true: jump bsbbr_11_t	|	false: jump bsbbr_12_f
bsbbr_11_t:
	heat(celldna22[0]) @ 23.0CELSIUS @ 1.0SECOND
	REPEAT_102[0] = REPEAT_101[0] - 1
bsbbr_12_f:
	recover21[0] = dispense(recovery_media)
	outgrowth21[0] = mix(celldna22[0], recover21[0]) @ 60.0SECOND
	heat(outgrowth21[0]) @ 30.0CELSIUS @ 3600.0SECOND
	train_pulse_reading1[0] = detect(fluorescence, outgrowth21[0]) @ 300.0SECOND
	if train_pulse_reading1[0] <= 80	|	true: jump bsbbif_13_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_14_f
bsbbif_13_t:
	dispose(outgrowth21[0])
bsbbif_14_f:
	PHI outgrowth22 = {outgrowth21,outgrowth2}
	plate21[0] = dispense(lb_kan_agar)
	colony21[0] = mix(outgrowth22[0], plate21[0]) @ 10.0SECOND
	dispose(colony21[0])
	NOP
